messages:
Harper (People Ops): Quick ask — interviewing for Senior Infra (onsite + remote loop) next Wed 11:00am PT. Need: panel cover, a scribe, and a small rubric tweak for 'system tradeoffs' weight. Who can take the panel or swap? cc @Alex @Sam
Alex: I can cover the panel at 11. Will need calendar invite and brief notes template.
Sam: I can't make 11 — I've got a release sync. Can do 2pm PT if that helps.
Jia: Which rubric version are we using? Last time we had v3.1 with infra anchors, but I saw a draft that adds "system tradeoffs" as a separate bullet. Link?
Harper (People Ops): Using v3.1 as base; we added a small anchor for tradeoffs in the "Design" section. Here's the doc: https://redwood.docs/interviews/rubrics/v3.1 (scroll to Design -> tradeoffs). Also: debrief is 15m, please put one-line recommendation + top-2 pros/cons.
Maya: Happy to scribe for 11am. Can run the notes and drop transcript into the candidate folder afterward.
Alex: Awesome. Can someone add a 10-min buffer before/after in the invite? Usually helps for setup + debrief.
Harper (People Ops): Yes — please add 10-min buffer on both sides. Suggested invite body below (feel free to copy):
```
SUBJECT: Senior Infra interview — panel 11:00am PT
LOCATION: Zoom (link) — please join 5 min early to check audio
AGENDA:
- 11:00-11:40 Interview (candidate + panel)
- 11:40-11:55 Debrief (panel only)
NOTES: Please add a one-line recommendation and 2 bullet pros/cons to the shared doc after debrief.
```
Sam: If Alex is covering, I'm happy to swap to 2pm slot with someone else next week.
Jia: Quick rubric clarifier: for "system tradeoffs" do we score 1-5 like other items? Or mark it as a pass/fail anchor?
Harper (People Ops): Score 1-5, but highlight any "critical risk" as a fail flag in the same comment. We'll normalize later if needed.
Alex: Tagging people-ops-bot to set reminder for scribe to add notes immediately after debrief. :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — pinging scribe 5 minutes before debrief and creating candidate folder note template.
Maya: Got it, I'll take notes and populate the template. Anything else for the panel?
Harper (People Ops): That's it. Thanks all. If anyone needs to swap, comment here and I'll update calendar. :pray:
Alex: Thanks — invite incoming from my calendar.
Sam: Thanks team, will follow up for 2pm swaps if needed.
